guidance: Use AWS Resilience Hub to assess whether critical workloads meet your Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) as defined by business SLAs. It identifies gaps between current and required resilience posture, estimates the cost of architectural improvements (e.g. Multi-AZ, Multi-Region, additional replicas), and provides the data needed for business stakeholders to decide whether to invest in improvements. Addressing this proactively is important — on major outages, CISOs are often held accountable for not identifying and remediating resilience risks in advance.
how_to_check: Have you analyzed the critical workloads with Resilience Hub? Do you have clear requirements for availability from the business? Is the current workload prepared to deliver the required SLA? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
